steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: This is Clients in the ConstructHUB CRM. Let's add someone new.

steps.caption: Client name
steps.narration: Type the client's name. It's the only thing you must fill in.

steps.caption: Email
steps.narration: Add their email. You'll need it to send them an estimate.

steps.caption: Service address
steps.narration: Service address is where the work will be.

steps.value: Wants oak floors in the front room. Call before 6.
steps.caption: Notes
steps.narration: Notes are for your team. Write what the client asked for.

steps.caption: On the list, with a portal
steps.chapter: The new client and their portal
steps.narration: Naomi is on your list, and her private portal was created automatically.

steps.caption: Open the client
steps.narration: Click her name to open her page.

steps.caption: Intake notes
steps.narration: Your notes are here, as intake notes. Only your team sees them.

steps.caption: Copy portal link
steps.narration: Copy portal link copies the link to her portal, ready to send to her.

steps.caption: See what the client sees
steps.narration: And See what the client sees opens the portal the way she sees it.

steps.caption: Menu: Clients
steps.narration: You'll find Clients in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to add a client | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of adding a client in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will fill in the New client form, find the new client on your list, and see where their private portal link is on their page.
